label: Who We Are
title: Strategic Partners in Clinical Excellence
paragraphs: MFD Research is a specialized clinical research operations consulting firm helping sponsors, CROs, biotech organizations, and research sites strengthen operational execution, site readiness, quality systems, and trial delivery.

Founded by Michael Delgado, CCRC, the firm brings more than {years} years of hands-on clinical research leadership across site operations, sponsor partnerships, regulatory readiness, staff development, and multi-therapeutic trial execution.
Whether you’re building a new research capability or strengthening an existing program, we focus on practical, compliant execution—so your teams are ready to deliver with confidence.
quote: Building world-class clinical research operations requires both the science of compliance and the art of leadership.
